notes: τὴν ψυχήν takes 'my' on the article under rule 20's second arm (no genitive pronoun present), while τὸν δρόμον μου leaves its article unrepresented under rule 20 proper — one verse writing both, which is what shows the test is availability.
'so that' heads on 'so', the word that glosses ὡς; οὐδενός takes the discontinuous 'not ... any' headed on 'any' under rule 69.
